definitions.explanation: To rouse someone from sleep. The transitive counterpart to {起|お}きる (to wake up oneself).
To help someone or something stand up from a lying or fallen position.
To cause something to happen, often used for events, problems, or incidents.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}6{時|じ}に{起|お}こしてください。
examples.english: Please wake me up at 6 in the morning.
examples.notes: {起|お}こして is the te-form used for requests

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{起|お}こさないように{静|しず}かにしてください。
examples.english: Please be quiet so as not to wake the children.
examples.notes: {起|お}こさないように = so as not to wake

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}を{起|お}こしてしまった。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {起|お}きる (intransitive, to wake up/get up). Pattern: Xを{起|お}こす (wake X up / cause X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state or ongoing action. {起|お}こしている = 'has woken (someone) up' or 'is in the process of waking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{人|ひと}を{起|お}こす (wake someone up)
・{事故|じこ}を{起|お}こす (cause an accident)
・{問題|もんだい}を{起|お}こす (cause a problem)
・{奇跡|きせき}を{起|お}こす (bring about a miracle)
・{行動|こうどう}を{起|お}こす (take action)

NUANCE: For 'wake up,' this verb focuses on the person doing the waking. {起|お}こす someone ≠ {起|お}きる (oneself). The pair is important:
・{母|はは}が{私|わたし}を{起|お}こした (Mom woke me up)
・{私|わたし}は6{時|じ}に{起|お}きた (I woke up at 6)

REGISTER: Neutral.
